title: Nonprofit Hospital Executive Pay vs Charity Care
headline: 106 nonprofit hospital chief executives received more in reported compensation than their hospitals gave in charity care.
headline_sub: The count covers all 717 nonprofit hospital systems with revenue over $100 million, general, children’s and specialty, using each hospital's own IRS filings. Of the 106, 83 run general hospitals, 9 children’s hospitals and 14 specialty hospitals. Together the 106 received $137.8M in reported compensation; their hospitals gave $53.2M to patients who could not pay.
